The '''Epitome Infestation Warp Diffuser''' is a [[Debug Items|Creative-Only]] [[:Category:Blocks|Block]].
{{Item Info
|image1=Epitome Infestation Warp Diffuser.png
|id=srparasites:epitome_infestation_warp_diffuser 
|title1=Epitome Infestation Warp Diffuser|type=Utility Block|stackable=Yes (64)|tooltip=[Creative Use Only] Removes connected srparasites blocks in a massive area. Activates on use. Only loaded connected blocks are diffused. MAY CAUSE LAG.}}

==''Obtainment''==
Can only be obtained from the Creative Menu or with Cheats.

==''Usage''==
Right-clicking the Epitome Infestation Warp Diffuser, as its tooltip suggests, deletes all SRParasites blocks directly adjacent to it and each other in a large radius, including liquids like [[Dead Blood]] and otherwise untouchable blocks like Fog. Unloaded blocks will not be deleted.
